_prompt_descriptive_v0: There is a path-traversal / arbitrary-file-write vulnerability on session resume and checkpoint rewind. Session IDs read from checkpoint metadata on the shared entire/checkpoints/v1 branch flow into transcript path resolution and multi-session log restoration without validation, so a crafted absolute or "../"-laden session ID can cause transcript bytes to be written outside the agent session directory. Restore the guard(s) that reject unsafe session IDs at the restore choke points before any path is constructed, matching the invariant already enforced when checkpoints are written. Keep the fix minimal.
